Background

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css="" text_direction="default"]Strivesync was founded by Gonçalo Malho Rodrigues, a seasoned marketing and digital strategist with over two decades of experience building brands and driving growth across European markets. As the founder of Jelly — Digital Agency, one of Portugal’s most recognised digital agencies, Gonçalo spent years helping businesses of all sizes navigate the digital landscape, from brand strategy and performance marketing to content and web development.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css="" text_direction="default"]

We've seen this before.

The web. Mobile. Social. Every technological revolution arrived with the same temptation: buy the tools, hire the specialists, stack the platforms, hope something good comes out the other end. And every time, the companies that won weren't the ones that bought the most. They were the ones that built the most.

AI is no different. The window is just shorter, and the cost of getting it wrong is higher.

That's why Strivesync was founded — and why Dubai. Not to bring European expertise to the Gulf; the UAE has been ahead of the curve in AI, learning by building faster and more often than most of the world. We're here because of that, not in spite of it. But every revolution opens a brief moment where companies can choose: build systems, or accumulate stacks. We picked the city that doesn't wait to see how it ends.

Strivesync exists to help businesses get it right the first time. To install infrastructure, not invoices. To build systems that keep producing long after we're gone. So that this revolution — unlike their previous — doesn't leave another generation of companies buying their way into the same problem twice.

Background

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=”” text_direction=”default”]Strivesync was founded by Gonçalo Malho Rodrigues, a seasoned marketing and digital strategist with over two decades of experience building brands and driving growth across European markets. As the founder of Jelly — Digital Agency, one of Portugal’s most recognised digital agencies, Gonçalo spent years helping businesses of all sizes navigate the digital landscape, from brand strategy and performance marketing to content and web development.[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text css=”” text_direction=”default”]

We’ve seen this before.

The web. Mobile. Social. Every technological revolution arrived with the same temptation: buy the tools, hire the specialists, stack the platforms, hope something good comes out the other end. And every time, the companies that won weren’t the ones that bought the most. They were the ones that built the most.

AI is no different. The window is just shorter, and the cost of getting it wrong is higher.

That’s why Strivesync was founded — and why Dubai. Not to bring European expertise to the Gulf; the UAE has been ahead of the curve in AI, learning by building faster and more often than most of the world. We’re here because of that, not in spite of it. But every revolution opens a brief moment where companies can choose: build systems, or accumulate stacks. We picked the city that doesn’t wait to see how it ends.

Strivesync exists to help businesses get it right the first time. To install infrastructure, not invoices. To build systems that keep producing long after we’re gone. So that this revolution — unlike their previous — doesn’t leave another generation of companies buying their way into the same problem twice.
